predecessors.name: Soviet Union
predecessors.text: the Uzbek SSR: 'On 27 October 1924, the Uzbek Soviet Socialist Republic was created', with the autonomous republic of Karakalpakstan inside it

ledger.x: 31 August 1991: Uzbekistan declares independence from the USSR.
2000: the receding Aral Sea leaves another strip of Karakalpakstan dry.
2002: Bagys goes to Kazakhstan in the border settlement.
2006: the shrinking South Aral leaves more of Karakalpakstan dry.
17 November 2022: Uzbekistan cedes 156 km2 to Kyrgyzstan in the final border treaty.
2024: the Kyrgyz enclave of Barak inside Uzbekistan ends.

certainty.note: The frontiers are the Soviet republic lines of 1924-1929 (Kyrgyzstan–Uzbekistan page: the border 'assumed its current position in 1929'); the Kyrgyz and Tajik stretches were not yet delimited by treaty, and in 1999-2000 Uzbekistan began…

Kazakhstan: treaties of 16 November 2001 and 9 September 2002 (in force 2003); Kyrgyzstan: final treaty of November 2022; Tajikistan: 'landmark border deals' of 2018 whose terms the page does not give.
